section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews literature on cosmetic surgery uptake and predictors of acceptance, noting a paucity of quantitative studies outside Western samples. The present study aims to examine the factor structure of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale and correlates of acceptance (including body appreciation and self-reported BMI) among adults in Brazil.
section_summary.evidence_source: "the present study sought to examine acceptance of cosmetic surgery and its correlates among adults in Brazil... we examined the factor structure of the most widely used scale... an additional aim of the present study was to examine correlates... and weight status (operationalised as self-reported BMI)."
